aggregation: Extend stable same-fragment linear bases into poorly supported cut regions. Keep all material volumes. Exact reduced inertia E.T diag(m) E; never relump after aggregation. No cross-fragment source or erasure of history.
transfer: Mass-orthogonal state projection, with explicit measured projection errors/energy; no hidden resets, energy correction impulses or loss labelled fracture.
stage_A: Targeted controls: reference/algebra, nonuniform state transfer, repeat previous oblique/partial/corner failures and held-out cuts, temporal refinement versus unmodified v17, independence and history transfer. Follow the recorded final numerical refinement; stop if it fails.
stage_B: Only if A passes: equivalent GPU dynamics, matched CPU/GPU checks, bounded fixed-topology throughput with clear exclusions. No complete tomato or RL claim without contact/history/robot/reset checks.
stage_C: Do not launch physical cutting or change engine automatically. Report retained limitations and next gating decision.
stop: Two-hour focused cap; each run <=600 s. Preserve failures. Stop substantive accuracy failure of the final selector after recorded diagnosis after finite timestep diagnosis, or a failed early cost screen. No accuracy relaxation or physical-law change.
change: Keep substantially supported cut-region nodes independent; only aggregate eligible weakly supported nodes. Retain exact reduced mass, all physical material and frozen force/position/velocity/energy screens.
support_fraction_definition: Original row-sum nodal mass / (rho*h^3). This is a declared numerical support selector, not mass scaling or material deletion.
selection: Predeclared primary 1e-8; if primary fails response equivalence, compare the more conservative 1e-12 retaining additional modes. Both must undergo the same temporal and response screens. No unbounded threshold tuning. Secondary chosen before any dynamic accuracy runs.
